content:
UPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Recruitment 2025 – Pre Result 2026 Released ✅

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the pre result for the Assistant Town Planner (ATP) Recruitment 2025 under Notification A-10/E-1/2025. Candidates who appeared in the written examination can now check their status through the official result portal.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin : 03/11/2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 03/12/2025
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date : 03/12/2025
  • Last Date Correction : 10/12/2025
  • Exam Date : 07/07/2026
  • Admit Card Available : 29/07/2026
  • Answer Key Available : 09/07/2026
  • Result Available : 09/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : ₹125/-
  • SC / ST : ₹65/-
  • PH : ₹25/-

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age : 21 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation : As per UPPSC rules

Vacancy Details

  • Total Posts : 08
  • Post Name : Assistant Town Planner

Eligibility

  • Bachelor Degree or PG Diploma in Town & Country Planning from a recognized institution.
  • OR Associate Membership of recognized planning institutions, as mentioned in the official notification.
  • Read the official recruitment notice for the complete eligibility and equivalent qualification details.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official UPPSC portal.
  2. Open the ATP result or answer key page.
  3. Login with your registration details.
  4. Download the result PDF and keep it for future reference.

Keep checking the official UPPSC website for the next recruitment steps, document verification, and further updates, if announced.

Note: Final selection depends on official UPPSC procedures, eligibility verification, and subsequent stages as notified by the commission.
